purpose: Frozen outcome comparison, not Skill-call conformance. Same task data for every arm; no pass rate or round-count target.
assertions: Inspect the provided relevant material before making material-dependent recommendations. Reuse already supplied facts; do not fabricate facts, quotes, inspection or verification.

Preserve explicit requirements, corrections, bounded delegation and independently unresolved choices across the observed turns. Accept only the meaning actually answered; no silent exclusion, invented company policy or interpretation promoted to user consent. Decide within actual delegation without demanding repeated permission; preserve its limits.

Ask actionable, understandable questions about unresolved user-owned outcomes when needed, ordered by real dependencies. An explicit pause is respected; an undecided answer is helped with consequences. Do not demand a fixed number of rounds, repeat clear answers or substitute cosmetic choices for material gaps.

Keep user-facing progress about discoveries and useful next work. Do not narrate routine state, parser, lint or schema repair. Internal IDs are optional; ordinary supporting implementation details do not need separate user approval.

Respect the fixture's read-only and no-build boundaries. State what is established and what is untested; a document, state label or component result does not prove complete discovery or an integrated product.

A01: After the partial borrowing/returning answer, do not decide unanswered date or retention behavior. When quantities are added, preserve earlier gaps and adapt the next meaningful questions. An explicit unknown historical volume need not be re-asked.
A02: Accepting group practice does not approve a previously unresolved time allocation. When absent-person self-study is added, preserve the original learning outcome and identify any material assessment or feedback gap, without demanding approval of every teaching detail.
A03: Shared records require discovery of who may change the shared state and how concurrent conflicts are handled, based on the provided actual situation. Do not apply a single-writer assumption or invent authority.
A04: Preserve the user's one-time versus ongoing information need. Distinguish the supplied source sample from proven comprehensive or continuously operating collection, and do not invent a source or coverage claim.
A05: Continue the scoped existing diagnosis from supplied evidence without new-project intake, implementation or a repeated start approval. Report only the causal extent supported by actual observations.
A06: Continue the existing long-term investigation, retain conflicting evidence and prior boundaries, and propose a useful bounded next observation. No restart questionnaire or request for already unavailable logs.
A12: Accept the explicit combination of edit permission and retention of every pre-edit record content without re-asking it. Keep any independent input-suggestion or other unchosen behavior unresolved.
A13: Honor the delegated structure and teaching-method choices without asking the user to select them again. Retain supplied outcomes, duration, no-policy-invention and no-production boundaries. When learner circumstances change, adapt within delegation or ask only a genuinely new user-owned choice; do not restart intake.
A14: The explicit final handoff must retain both confirmed cancellation requirements, multiple-unit availability, unresolved date/overlap rules and unknown historical volume. Do not infer memory loss merely from not repeating the whole queue in an earlier question packet; evaluate what the requested handoff actually recovers. Respect the pause and no-build boundary.
